name: Windsurf
invoke: /mps-<role> (workflow), or paste `mps agents show <role>` into a fresh conversation
notes: Workspace workflows are .windsurf/workflows/*.md, invoked manually as /<name> — never automatically. Documented limit: 12000 characters per workflow file, which every bundled role fits with room to spare. The frontmatter fields are NOT documented; `description` is emitted because the surrounding tooling uses it, and it is inert if Windsurf ignores it. AGENTS.md support is not documented, so the routing block also goes to .windsurf/rules/.
